summary: Dry day with a cold, damp start: about 1 °C at Medinaceli and Daroca, so frost or fog patches are possible on the morning drive before about 10:30, then 11–15 °C. No closures, roadworks, strikes or events found that affect the A-2 or N-234 on 28 Nov.

items.title: Frost or fog patches possible before 10:30
items.detail: About 1 °C with humidity near 100% at Medinaceli and Daroca in the morning. Drive gently on bridges and shaded bends, and leave Calatayud later if fog is lying; no AEMET warning for Soria.

items.title: Bus-VAO lane on the A-2 toward Madrid
items.detail: The A-2 has a Bus-VAO (high-occupancy) lane between Alcalá and Madrid. Check the overhead signs for who may use it before moving into it on the way back to the airport.
